reaction: That distinction between the wave moving and the cord staying put is satisfying.

effect: Plucking the cord completed the goal, and moving the bridge showed that a shorter vibrating length produces a higher note.
reaction: It was satisfying to hear the same machine work as both a wave display and an instrument.

mostWorthwhile.text: Making the standing-wave loops was worthwhile: the nearly still point made the meeting of opposing disturbances visible.

leastWorthwhile.text: My two early attempts to fit the bridge and soundbox were unproductive; the required order was not yet clear.

surprise.text: The paper rider stayed near its own position while the disturbance travelled along the cord.

arbitrary.text: The soundbox only became available after the standing-wave adjustment. That order was not obvious to me, although the later bridge fitting had a clear purpose.

continue.text: Yes. The rider, standing waves and changing pitch made the mechanisms worth exploring, despite the unclear fitting order.
